text: wyckoff: "price above all averages; lens resistance strong". You also write "longer averages still inverted" - that is the context Steenbarger asks for, and it fails my gate: the 50-day under the 200-day voids Template criteria 2 and 4 (C3) whatever price does above them. A thrust over a falling 200 is a stage 1 repair (C2), and day_vol 0.94 on the move fails C6 too. What clears me: ma50 over a rising ma200, then a base and pivot cleared on volume. Until then OPPOSE.
